title: Бытие 14 — Genesis 14
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Эти цари объединили силы в ___ Сидим.
cases.translation: These kings joined forces in the valley of Siddim.
cases.explain: В marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → долине.

cases.sentence: Четыре царя захватили все имущество ___ и Гаморы.
cases.translation: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah.
cases.explain: Possession — the goods of Sodom — is expressed by the genitive → Содома.

cases.sentence: Он погнался за четырьмя ___ и преследовал их до Дана.
cases.translation: He chased after the four kings and pursued them as far as Dan.
cases.explain: The preposition за in the sense of pursuit (гнаться за — to chase after) takes the instrumental → царями.

cases.sentence: Он преследовал их до Ховы, к северу от ___.
cases.translation: He pursued them to Hobah, to the north of Damascus.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from / of) takes the genitive → Дамаска.

cases.sentence: Он созвал 318 способных к бою ___, рожденных в его доме.
cases.translation: He called out 318 able fighting men born in his household.
cases.explain: After a large number, the counted noun takes the genitive plural → мужчин.

cases.sentence: Один из тех, кто спасся, пришел и рассказал об этом еврею ___.
cases.translation: One who had escaped came and told this to Abram the Hebrew.
cases.explain: The person told (the recipient of рассказал) goes in the dative → Авраму.

cases.sentence: Царь Содома сказал Авраму: «Отдай мне моих ___».
cases.translation: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me my people.”
cases.explain: Direct object of отдай (give back); for animate plurals the accusative equals the genitive form → людей.

cases.sentence: Мелхиседек, ___ Салима, вынес хлеб и вино.
cases.translation: Melchizedek, king of Salem, brought out bread and wine.
cases.explain: Царь stands in apposition to the subject Мелхиседек, so it stays nominative → царь.

reading.ru: Эти цари объединили силы в долине Сидим, где теперь соленое море.
reading.question: What is now located in the valley of Siddim?
reading.explain: The text notes that the valley of Siddim is where the Salt Sea now is.

reading.ru: Они забрали также Аврамова племянника Лота, который жил в Содоме, и все его имущество.
reading.question: Whom did the four kings carry off from Sodom?
reading.explain: They took Lot, Abram's nephew who lived in Sodom, along with his goods.

reading.ru: Когда Авраам услышал, что его родственник в плену, он созвал 318 способных к бою мужчин, рожденных в его доме, погнался за четырьмя царями и преследовал их до Дана.
reading.question: How many trained men did Abram lead out to rescue Lot?
reading.explain: Abram called out 318 able men born in his household to pursue the kings.

reading.ru: Мелхиседек, царь Салима, вынес хлеб и вино.
reading.question: What did Melchizedek, king of Salem, bring out?
reading.explain: Melchizedek, the priest-king of Salem, brought out bread and wine.

reading.ru: Аврам дал ему от всего десятую часть.
reading.question: What did Abram give to Melchizedek?
reading.explain: Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of all he had recovered.

reading.ru: Царь Содома сказал Авраму, «Отдай мне моих людей, а добро оставь себе».
reading.question: What did the king of Sodom ask Abram to do with the people and the goods?
options: Return the people, keep the goods
Keep both the people and the goods
reading.correct: Return the people, keep the goods
reading.explain: The king of Sodom asked Abram to give back the people but to keep the goods for himself.
